channel.title: RateLog — JetBrains AI Assistant changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for JetBrains AI Assistant, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: JetBrains AI Assistant — Org credits extended to 12-month validity
item.description: [↑ improved] Announced transitioning org/business AI licensing from fixed seat quotas toward on-demand credits with validity extended from 30 days to 12 months, rolling out through July–August 2026.

item.title: JetBrains AI Assistant — Quotas tied to plan price, shrinking for heavy users
item.description: [↓ reduced] Replaced its opaque per-plan quota with a rule that each plan's AI-Credit allowance equals its USD price (plus a small bonus on Ultimate). JetBrains acknowledged quotas were shrinking for a meaningful share of users, especially heavy Junie agent users, since old quotas had been set unsustainably high as a promotional measure.
